title: GraphRAG-LTM: A Layered Threat Modeling Framework for Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) uses document-derived knowledge graphs to assemble evidence for large language model (LLM) answers. Its security depends on both the seed chunks retrieved for a query and the graph evidence assembled from them, yet attacks on this evidence path remain underexplored. We introduce GraphRAG-LTM, a Layered Threat Modeling framework that tests three nested levels of attacker access. BB Query uses ranking feedback to make query edits under a semantic-similarity constraint and demote relevant seed chunks. WB Query uses retriever gradients for the same objective. Graph-aware WB keeps the white-box adversarial query and deletes bridge triplets from the query-specific evidence graph, disrupting multi-hop evidence propagation through localized graph edits. translated_title: GraphRAG-LTM：一个针对图检索增强生成攻击的分层威胁建模框架
translated_abstract: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）利用从文档中构建的知识图谱来为大语言模型（LLM）的回答组装证据。其安全性既取决于针对查询检索到的种子文本块，也取决于由这些文本块组装而成的图谱证据，然而针对这一证据路径的攻击仍鲜有研究。我们提出了 GraphRAG-LTM，一个分层威胁建模框架，用于测试三个嵌套层级的攻击者访问权限。BB Query 利用排序反馈在语义相似度约束下对查询进行编辑，从而降低相关种子文本块的排名。WB Query 利用检索器的梯度实现同样的目标。图感知的 WB（Graph-aware WB）在保留白盒对抗性查询的基础上，从查询特定的证据图中删除桥接三元组，通过局部图编辑破坏多跳证据传播。在多个数据集、检索器和 LLM 骨干模型上的实验表明，仅凭排序反馈即可降低答案质量，梯度访问会进一步强化查询攻击，而删除桥接三元组……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 GraphRAG-LTM 分层威胁建模框架，通过黑盒查询、白盒查询和图感知白盒三个递进攻击层级，首次系统揭示了 GraphRAG 证据生成路径的安全脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GraphRAG-LTM, a layered threat modeling framework that systematically exposes the security vulnerabilities of GraphRAG's evidence pipeline through three escalating attack levels: black-box query, white-box query, and graph-aware white-box attacks.
